search_unit: BUYER x PURCHASE_TRIGGER x BOOK_BUYING_JOB x SEARCH_OR_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL x UNMET_SCENARIO
discovery_directions: existing book demand and unmet scenarios
rules: topic interest and external trends do not establish demand for our edition
service spending does not establish book demand
a listing establishes supply, not purchases
BSR reviews suggestions and trends are dated proxies, not unit sales
zero sales without verified availability and impressions do not establish absent demand
small niches are judged against production cost competition and owner attention rather than rejected by size
existing assets reduce production cost but never compensate for weak need or weak book demand
temporary opportunities must retain a meaningful selling window after preparation
public-domain source text does not grant rights to a modern translation illustration or branded packaging
a useful book must work without personal service
RN7R-009 is reserved for a possible digital direction and excluded from active KDP discovery
